meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track, and read team goals + KPIs via Hivemind from openclaw. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一管理目标和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a unified way to manage goals and task progress

howto.what: Claude 可以用此技能创建、跟踪团队目标和关键绩效指标（KPI），也能处理任务和待办事项。它会先搜索已有内容避免重复，再创建目标或任务，并保存详细上下文以便后续恢复。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项等可衡量的内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新目标：提升用户留存率
say.note: 创建一个名为「提升用户留存率」的新目标

say.text: 给目标添加一个KPI：周活跃用户数目标1000
保存这个任务：在webhook处理器添加限流，稍后继续
say.note: 存储一个带上下文的任务，方便后续恢复

howto.what_en: Claude can create and track team goals and KPIs, as well as tasks and to-dos. It first searches for existing items to avoid duplicates, then creates goals or tasks with detailed context for later resumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a goal, objective, KPI, milestone, task, to-do, reminder, or any actionable work item.

say_en.text: Create a new goal: improve user retention
say_en.note: Creates a new goal named 'improve user retention'

say_en.text: Add a KPI to the goal: weekly active users target 1000
say_en.note: Adds a KPI to an existing goal

say_en.text: Save this task: add rate limiting to webhook handler, resume later
say_en.note: Stores a task with context for later resumption
